## Summary

[Partial] Drive straight at moderate speeds, then test turns while monitoring lights for a VDC sensitivity issue. [t678]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

2. Test by taking turns or navigating curves while monitoring the VDC and SLIP lights.

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] The issue often manifests as the VDC light flickering on and off during turns rather than staying solid. [t678]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Assuming the problem is mechanical when it might be electronic sensor confusion due to tire size changes. [t678]
